cases.sentence: Рувимиты и гадиты, у которых были очень большие стада, увидели, что земли Иозера и Галлада хороши для ___.
cases.translation: The Reubenites and Gadites, who had a very large number of livestock, saw that the land of Jazer and Gilead was good for livestock.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition 'для' (for) indicating the purpose or use.

cases.sentence: Они пришли к Моисею, священнику Элиазару и вождям народа и сказали: "Это они, по совету Валаама, заставили израилетян изменить ___.
cases.translation: They said: 'It was they who, at Balaam's advice, caused the Israelites to be unfaithful to the Lord.'
cases.explain: The dative case after the preposition 'к' (toward/to) indicates unfaithfulness toward the Lord.

cases.sentence: Зачем вы отбиваете у израилетян охоту перейти в ___, которую дал им Господь?
cases.translation: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the Lord has given them?
cases.explain: The accusative case is used for the direct object after the transitive verb 'перейти' (to cross over into).

cases.sentence: Это земля, которую Господь покорил народу Израиля, хороша для скота, а у твоих слуг есть ___ .
cases.translation: The land which the Lord has conquered for the people of Israel is good for livestock, and your servants have livestock.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the predicate noun after the verb 'есть' (to have/exist).

cases.sentence: Вы будете готовы вооружиться и идти перед израилетянами, пока не приведем их в их ___.
cases.translation: You will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel until we bring them to their inheritance.
cases.explain: The accusative case is used for the direct object after the transitive verb 'приведем' (will bring to).

cases.sentence: Мы не вернемся домой, пока каждый израилетянин не получит свой надел в ___.
cases.translation: We will not return home until each Israelite receives his own inheritance.
cases.explain: The prepositional case is used after the preposition 'в' (in) indicating location or state.

cases.sentence: Моисей сказал им, «Если вы сделаете это, если вооружитесь, чтобы воевать для ___, и каждый из вас переправится за Иордан...
cases.translation: Moses said to them: 'If you will do this, if you will arm yourselves for war for the Lord...'
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition 'для' (for) indicating the purpose or beneficiary.

cases.sentence: Гадиты и Рувимиты ответили, «Мы твои слуги, мы сделаем так, как сказал ___.
cases.translation: The Gadites and Reubenites answered: 'We are your servants; we will do as the Lord has said.'
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the subject of the dependent clause introduced by 'как' (as).

reading.ru: Рувимиты и гадиты, у которых были очень большие стада, увидели, что земли Иозера и Галлада хороши для скота.
reading.question: Why did the Reubenites and Gadites show interest in the land of Jazer and Gilead?
options: Because it was close to Egypt
Because they had large herds and the land was good for livestock
Because Moses commanded them to settle there
reading.correct: Because they had large herds and the land was good for livestock
reading.explain: The text states they had very large herds and saw that the land of Jazer and Gilead was good for livestock.

reading.ru: Зачем вы отбиваете у израилетян охоту перейти в землю, которую дал им Господь?
reading.question: What was Moses' concern about the request of the Reubenites and Gadites?
options: They wanted to take too much land
They wanted to discourage the other Israelites from entering Canaan
They refused to fight for Israel
They demanded payment from the other tribes
reading.correct: They wanted to discourage the other Israelites from entering Canaan
reading.explain: Moses questioned why they would discourage the Israelites from crossing into the land the Lord had given them.

reading.ru: Так сделали ваши отцы, когда я посылал их из Кадеш-Барнеа осмотреть эту землю.
reading.question: What example from the past did Moses use to warn the Reubenites and Gadites?
options: The conquest of Jericho by Joshua
The rebellion of the fathers at Kadesh-barnea
The failure of the golden calf generation
reading.correct: The rebellion of the fathers at Kadesh-barnea
reading.explain: Moses reminded them that their fathers had acted similarly when sent from Kadesh-barnea to scout the land, referring to the original generation's refusal to enter Canaan.

reading.ru: Мы построим здесь загоны для скота и города для наших жен и детей, а потом будем готовы вооружиться и идти перед израилетянами, пока не приведем их в их надел.
reading.question: What compromise solution did the Reubenites and Gadites propose?
options: They would build cities and fortifications only
They would stay on the east side of the Jordan to guard the borders
They would build settlements for their families and then fight alongside Israel
They would send their young men to fight while the others remained
reading.correct: They would build settlements for their families and then fight alongside Israel
reading.explain: They proposed to build pens for livestock and cities for their wives and children, then arm themselves to go before the Israelites to their land.

reading.ru: Если Гадиты и Рувимиты, все вооруженные для битвы, переправятся с вами за Иордан перед Господом, то, когда земля покорится вам, отдайте им во владение землю Галаада.
reading.question: Under what condition would the Reubenites and Gadites receive the land of Gilead?
options: If they paid tribute to Israel
If they built cities before the others crossed the Jordan
If they crossed the Jordan armed and fought before the Lord until the land was subdued
If they promised never to return to Egypt
reading.correct: If they crossed the Jordan armed and fought before the Lord until the land was subdued
reading.explain: Moses stated that if they would pass over with the others armed and the land was conquered, then the land of Gilead would be given to them as their possession.

reading.ru: Тогда Моисей отдал Гадитам, Рувимитам и половине рода Монассии сына Иосифа царство Сигона, царя Амореев, и царство Ога, царя Башана, всю землю с ее городами и их окрестностями.
reading.question: What lands did Moses allot to the Gadites, Reubenites, and half-tribe of Manasseh?
options: The lands of Egypt and Sinai
The kingdoms of Sihon and Og with their cities
The land west of the Jordan River
The territories of the Canaanites only
reading.correct: The kingdoms of Sihon and Og with their cities
reading.explain: The text states Moses gave them 'царство Сигона, царя Амореев, и царство Ога, царя Башана, всю землю с ее городами' (the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan with all its cities).
